title: Integrating machine learning for the identification of ubiquitination-associated genes in moyamoya disease.
authors: Niu, Hongchuan; Wang, Xilong; Zhou, Zhenyu; Liu, Yutong; He, Shihao; Zhao, Yuanli
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习识别烟雾病中泛素化相关基因，虽涉及转录因子网络构建，但核心是疾病基因表达与免疫分析，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Moyamoya disease (MMD) is an infrequent cerebrovascular disorder typified by bilateral internal carotid artery obstruction, yet its pathogenic mechanism remains elusive. This study examines the role of epigenetic ubiquitination-related genes in MMD. METHODS: We utilized two datasets (GSE157628 and GSE141024) from the GEO database and sourced ubiquitination-related genes from the GeneCards database. Differentially expressed genes were identified, followed by Gene Ontology (GO), Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), and Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) to elucidate key gene functions. Machine learning techniques, including LASSO logistic regression and support vector machine, helped identify crucial genes. Immune characteristics were analyzed using single-sample gene set enrichment analysis, while transcription factors and miRNA-gene regulatory networks were constructed with the Citrome and Mircode databases. RESULTS: We identified three key ubiquitination-related genes-ANAPC11, UCHL1, and USP41-that may be involved in the pathogenesis of MMD. Further, we found that the serum UCHL1 expression level in MMD was significantly reduced, and knocking down UCHL1 could enhance the migration ability of human brain vascular smooth muscle cells (HBVSMCs), as verified by In vitro experiments. Immune infiltration analysis demonstrated significant correlations between these genes and various immune factors. Furthermore, we constructed a miRNA-gene network involving 30 miRNAs and identified secondary genes EXO1 and ISG15. DISCUSSION: Potential therapeutic drugs, including benzohydroxamic acid and PKC-beta inhibitors, were predicted to target these key genes, suggesting new avenues for MMD treatment.
abstract_zh: 引言：烟雾病（MMD）是一种罕见的脑血管疾病，以双侧颈内动脉闭塞为特征，但其发病机制仍不明确。本研究探讨表观遗传泛素化相关基因在MMD中的作用。方法：我们利用GEO数据库中的两个数据集（GSE157628和GSE141024），并从GeneCards数据库获取泛素化相关基因。鉴定差异表达基因后，进行基因本体论（GO）、京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）和基因集富集分析（GSEA）以阐明关键基因功能。采用机器学习技术，包括LASSO逻辑回归和支持向量机，帮助识别关键基因。使用单样本基因集富集分析免疫特征，同时利用Citrome和Mircode数据库构建转录因子和miRNA-基因调控网络。结果：我们识别出三个关键的泛素化相关基因——ANAPC11、UCHL1和USP41——可能参与MMD的发病机制。此外，我们发现MMD患者血清中UCHL1表达水平显著降低，且敲低UCHL1可增强人脑血管平滑肌细胞（HBVSMCs）的迁移能力，这已通过体外实验验证。免疫浸润分析显示这些基因与多种免疫因子之间存在显著相关性。进一步，我们构建了涉及30个miRNA的miRNA-基因网络，并识别出次级基因EXO1和ISG15。讨论：预测了潜在的治疗药物，包括苯并异羟肟酸和PKC-β抑制剂，可能靶向这些关键基因，为MMD治疗提供了新途径。
